content: {"episode_id":"ep-05056","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, which the payer letter states was denied because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents a patient with a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias, supported by diagnosis codes I49.9, I48.91, and R55. Per the note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period. We submit this documentation as the supporting clinical justification of medical necessity invited by the payer letter and request reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 615.60."}
